# routeros_routing_pimsm_instance (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the PIM-SM instance, referenced by the interface templates and the RP configuration.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `afi` (String) The address family this instance operates on.
- `bsm_forward_back` (Boolean) Allow the bootstrap messages to be forwarded back to the interface they were received on.
- `crp_advertise_contained` (Boolean) When acting as a candidate RP, advertise only the group ranges that are contained in the scope zone of the elected bootstrap router.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `rp_hash_mask_length` (Number) The length of the mask used by the RP hash function that distributes the group ranges between the candidate rendezvous points.
- `rp_static_override` (Boolean) If enabled, the statically configured rendezvous points take precedence over the ones learned from the bootstrap router.
- `ssm_range` (String) The group range that is treated as Source Specific Multicast. No shared tree is built for the groups inside this range.
- `switch_to_spt` (Boolean) Allow the last hop router to switch from the RP shared tree to the shortest path tree of the source.
- `switch_to_spt_bytes` (Number) The amount of bytes that has to be received within `switch_to_spt_interval` before the switch to the shortest path tree is performed.
- `switch_to_spt_interval` (String) The measurement interval used together with `switch_to_spt_bytes`.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
